data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2015 the syndicate carried opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 11.073m (opening balance). Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows prior-year adverse development concentrated in the 2013 underwriting year, resulting in an approximate gross strengthening of GBP 11.24m (c.101.5% of opening reserves). The movement was driven largely by adverse development on casualty/third party liability business and IBNR adjustments for older years.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was not stated as a single gross movement figure in narrative notes. The prior year movement was derived from the gross claims development triangle (gross column comparisons) on page 29 - confidence 0.8. LOB-level movements in the accounts are presented as net movements; gross LOB movements were not provided, so LOB amounts use the reported net prior-year movement breakdown and are therefore lower confidence (0.5). No specific named catastrophe events were identified in the report.
